advisory.text: When you find the target platforms, examine the project files for these signals:

advisory.correction: "Examine the project files for these signals:"

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: Do not move text from a Rule.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/loading-rules.md, lines 56 and 75 tell the agent not to move text from a Rule, which is not usual for the agent, but no file tells why this rule is necessary.
advisory.correction: "Do not move text from a Rule, because a project adds the text of a Rule to an entry file, and the extraction recommendation of that entry file is applicable to that text."

advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: After you move the text, examine the file size. If the file is more than a limit in "When you examine the file size", move more sections that have a specified condition. Move the largest section first. When the file is not more than each limit, stop. If the file is still more than a limit, add a warning. (advisory)
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/loading-rules.md, line 71 gives 5 steps in a sequence as one paragraph, but the same procedure for the edit job on lines 78 to 85 uses numbered items.
advisory.correction: Write the paragraph as a numbered list: "1. After you move the text, examine the file size. 2. If the file is more than a limit in "When you examine the file size", move more sections that have a specified condition. Move the largest section first. 3. When the file is not more than each limit, stop. 4. If the file is still more than a limit, add a warning. (advisory)"

advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: Select the reference file and its name as "When the write job makes a SKILL.md or entry-file text" tells you. (advisory)
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/loading-rules.md, lines 79 to 84 give steps in a sequence as bullets, and the step on line 81 that selects the reference file comes after the step on line 80 that moves the section.
advisory.correction: Write the steps as a numbered list in the sequence of the task: select the reference file and its name, move the largest whole section with a specified condition, write the heading and the pointer in the old place, and stop when the file is not more than each limit.
